about_the_game:
Dungeon Trick is a turn-based Roguelite JRPG. Assemble a team of four heroes and dive into randomized, dungeon encounters. With 13 unique classes and a dynamic card system that delivers boons and banes, every run offers strategic combat and hidden lore waiting to be discovered.

In the peaceful land of Averia lies a quiet, small town called Mirstone. One day, just on the outskirts of town, a dungeon emerged.

A strange energy surrounds the dungeon, drawing not only people but dangerous monsters into its maw. Many have wandered into the dungeon, but none have returned.

  • Navigate through randomized dungeon encounters.

  • Assemble and manage a team of four unique heroes, each bringing their strengths and abilities to the challenging combat.

  • Discover hidden bits of lore and narrative as you progress through the dungeon.

  • Utilize special card readings that introduce powerful boons and risky banes, dynamically altering every run.
